question: What ours does now, as predictions for CAP-VIEWLAYOUTS' not read lines, on the Paragraph mix p1 (one text block), layouts 0 to 5.
seenInScouting: Three scouting runs on Blocks Probe already showed: from no theme, layout 1 gives dark, 14 rows, 914.1 tall; on reopening no tile had the dark border, and tile 1 drew the next turn of the theme. So the mark prediction and the '' start are not blind.
themeTurn: Layouts 1, 3 and 5 turn the start by priorState.themeTurn at all 10 other starts, and layout 0 puts the start back: the table read on the Image mix holds on p1. Layout 3 also sets the rounded divider, and layout 0 takes it away.
dividerStart: Divider on with a start shape other than Wavy, for Slanted and Jagged: layouts 0, 1, 4 and 5 keep the start shape; layout 2 sets soft and layout 3 sets rounded; layout 0 after them puts the start shape back. A press on Wavy Shape changes nothing when Wavy is the shape already on, which is why the earlier press looked unclear.
undoPastOpening: Start Bright 1, open, pick 2, Undo, Undo again, past the opening: the theme goes back, the panel stays open, no tile marked. A pick after that starts from the section as it is then, not as it was on opening: layout 1 gives dark, not the turn of Bright 1.
undoKeyboard: Meta+z with the panel open does what the Undo button does and leaves the panel open; Meta+Shift+z does what Redo does.
mark: Opening a section that already matches a layout marks no tile, for a matching layout just picked and after a close.
panelTopWhileScrolling: With the panel open, the page scrolls under it and the panel stays where it opened.
